9.t: Working with data: putting it all together
q: Name the dependent variable and two control variables.
Dependent: bounce height. Controls: any two of same ball, same floor, drop not throw, same person reading the height.
Identify the anomaly and calculate the correct mean for 150 cm.
71 cm is the anomaly. Mean = (90 + 88) / 2 = 89 cm.
Describe the relationship and predict the bounce for a 250 cm drop. Explain your prediction.
The ball bounces to about 60% of its drop height each time (30 from 50, 60 from 100, 120 from 200): bounce height is proportional to drop height. So from 250 cm it should bounce about 150 cm.
